extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Orb uses the camera only when you allow a site to use it, for example on a video call.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orb uses the microphone only when you allow a site to use it, for example on a call or voice recording.
extendInfo.NSLocationUsageDescription: Orb shares your location only when you allow a site to use it.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Orb captures system audio only when you allow a site to share audio while screen sharing.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Orb needs access to the Documents folder only when you download a file there.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Orb saves downloads to your Downloads folder.
